description: In a steady state, items in a system = arrival rate × average time in the system (`L = λ × W`); it gives the average number of calls in flight.
A cap on in-flight calls (a semaphore); at least the average load, at most what the quota allows at mean latency.
The longest an item may wait; with drain rate `r` and budget `t`, a queue holds at most `r × t` items.
Required CPU-seconds per second divided by the utilization target, rounded up, within the cores left free.
Stop accepting work, drain what is queued and cancel what is left at a deadline.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
